ozlo - sleepbuds® 2, noise-masking sleep.description: Engineered by the team behind the original Bose Sleepbuds, Ozlo Sleepbuds 2 are built for exactly one job: helping you sleep through the noise. Not music earbuds adapted for bed — purpose-built sleep technology. Rather than fighting noise, Sleepbuds 2 cover it. A snug passive seal plus active sound masking layers soothing soundscapes over snoring, traffic, and thin hotel walls, so disruptions never reach you. Fall asleep to your own audio — a sleep playlist, a podcast, a meditation — streamed straight from your phone. Built-in biometric sensing detects when you've drifted off and switches automatically to masking sound, so you're not woken mid-episode. Flush-fit and feather-light with multiple ear tip sizes included, they stay comfortable all night — even face-down on a pillow. A 14-hour battery covers a full night with room to spare, and a personal in-ear alarm wakes you without waking your partner. Personalize your soundscapes, track your sleep, and see what your bedroom is really doing overnight in the Ozlo app.
